summary:
The only failure is the pre-existing `TutorialService` spec (missing `HttpClientTestingModule`), untouched and unrelated. All new specs pass.

Added a `HealthService` that calls `GET /health` (the `ApiInterceptor` prefixes `environment.apiUrl`, giving `/api/health`), a `Health { status }` model matching the contract's `status` field, and wired `AppComponent` to fetch it on init and render `API: ok` in the footer (`unavailable` on error, `unknown` before the response). The endpoint itself belongs to the backend repo (`realworld-dotnet`), which already ships it on `api-correction/a8e86da2e5ea`; I only built the frontend consumer. Smaller reading taken: one footer indicator, no new page or settings UI.
blockers: Not applied -- Implement the GET /api/health endpoint itself: Belongs to the counterpart backend repository; not editable here
conventions: Service HTTP paths are written relative (e.g. '/health'); the ApiInterceptor prefixes environment.apiUrl
Backend health is surfaced in the app footer as 'API: <status>', falling back to 'unavailable' on request error and 'unknown' before a response

visual_check.evidence: The /tutorials page footer renders the new health indicator ("API: <status>"); it reads "API: unavailable" because no backend is running in this environment (the tutorials list is likewise empty), so the wiring and placement are visibly correct and the literal "ok" text depends only on a live API.

endpoints.purpose: Fetch service health status shown in the app header.

context_sharing.notes: HealthService requests the relative path '/health'; an interceptor prefixes environment.apiUrl ('http://localhost:5001/api'), so the effective URL is GET /api/health. The response is read as lowercase camelCase 'status' (health.status) and is optional in the model — a missing/non-200 response falls back to 'unknown'/'unavailable' in the UI. The endpoint must stay anonymous (no auth header is sent). No other endpoints from the counterpart contract are missing; this side also consumes an unrelated '/tutorials' base path not covered by that contract.
